name: Steel
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of steel, particularly in relation to bows and weapons, to illustrate strength and divine empowerment in battle. In 2 Samuel 22:35 and Psalms 18:34, God teaches the hands to war so that even a bow of steel can be broken by human arms strengthened by Him. Job 20:24 portrays the bow of steel as a powerful weapon that strikes decisively, while Jeremiah 15:12 questions whether iron can break steel, highlighting the formidable nature of steel as a symbol of strength. Notably, the Revised Version sometimes translates "steel" as "brass," indicating the biblical text’s focus on strong metal as a metaphor for power and resilience.
